name: three-inspector-tests
description: End-to-end tests for the Three Inspector extension

scripts.build: npm run -s models && for f in a-loop b-ondemand c-old d-iframe e-webgpu demo; do esbuild src/$f.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=site/$f.js --log-level=warning; done
scripts.models: mkdir -p site/models && curl -sSLo site/models/Fox.glb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/main/Models/Fox/glTF-Binary/Fox.glb && curl -sSLo site/models/Duck.glb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/main/Models/Duck/glTF-Binary/Duck.glb
